comment: Measurement-epoch boundaries for the change-point detector. An entry says that before min_run_id, the named benchmarks measured something else, so their older readings are not history and must not seed a baseline. This is for investigated, documented changes in what a benchmark measures — never for silencing a suspected regression, which is what the paired sentinel confirmation is for. Each entry cites the optimization-log fragment that established it.

epochs.reason: PR #98 moved the workload bodies into the shared bench/parallel_phase_support.h so the thread-scaling sweep could reuse them, turning internal-linkage locals into weak templates. A paired scan of all ten gated cells measured +26.1% on tile_touch_pool_w4 and +31.5% on tile_touch_serial with the library untouched, so readings either side of this run measure different harness codegen around the same call.
